messages:
incident-bot: AUTO-PAGE: metrics-scrape-gap detected for 'prometheus-main' (gap > 15m). PagerDuty: https://pd.example/INC12345 :rotating_light: - page fired to eng-sre, severity: P2.
Kira Patel: acked. I’m taking this one. tagging @Anna for on-call handoff. any initial customer-facing impact?
James L: looking at grafana — prometheus scrape_samples_total for scrape-job 'node-exporter' dropped to 0 across 2 clusters around 02:11 UTC. kafka consumer lag for metrics-ingest.topic is climbing (consumer-group metrics-ingest-consumer -> lag ~ 120k).
Kira Patel: thanks james. running quick pod check.
Kira Patel: ```kubectl get pods -n monitoring -l app=scrape-proxy -o wide
NAME                                  READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
scrape-proxy-5b7df5c9c4-2m8xk        0/1     CrashLoop  5          3m
scrape-proxy-5b7df5c9c4-hq4rz        1/1     Running    0          23h
```
Miguel R: seeing OOMs on one replica earlier, looks like scrape-proxy occasionally spikes mem when a large scrape wave hits. consumer side: ```kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --describe --group metrics-ingest-consumer``` shows partitions with lag. I can spin up extra consumers.
Kira Patel: scaling scrape-proxy to 5 replicas to spread load: `kubectl scale deploy/scrape-proxy -n monitoring --replicas=5` — doing now.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: INC12345 acknowledged by Kira Patel. Escalation suppressed for 30m.
Anna O'Neil: thanks Kira — oncall here. customer impact? Lia, any inbound tickets? :eyes:
Lia Chen: Support: two affected customers flagged dashboards empty in last 30m. Tickets #SUP-5981 (Customer A) and #SUP-5982 (Customer B). I've added the incident tag and a short status note.
James L: recommending a controlled restart of the remaining scrape-proxy pod to clear conn pools: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/scrape-proxy -n monitoring` — initiating.
Kira Patel: restarted. watching logs now. saw repeated `tcp: connection reset by peer` to a subset of exporters (custom exporter behind ELB). log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T02:12:04Z] scrape-proxy error: dial tcp x.x.x.x:9100: connect: connection reset by peer
[2026-03-15T02:12:05Z] scrape-proxy info: backoff retry 1 for target customer-exporter-12
```
Miguel R: scaled metrics-ingest consumers + increased max.poll.records. lag dropping from 120k -> 18k in ~4m. kafka partitions rebalanced. :thumbsup:
Kira Patel: confirming prometheus metrics flowing again for most targets. grafana shows scrape_samples_total > 0 and Uptime panels recovering.
Lia Chen: I've posted to status.redwood.com: "Partial degradation: some metrics dashboards delayed due to upstream scrape failures; engineers investigating. Affected customers notified via support." Link: https://status.redwood/incident-3830054321
Anna O'Neil: good. can we capture why the exporter connections reset? might be network or exporter-side OOM. add to RCA.
James L: opened ticket INFR-2174 for postmortem and assigned to me + Kira. immediate follow-ups: 1) increase scrape-proxy memory limit for resilience, 2) add horizontalPodAutoscaler for spikes, 3) add alert for consumer lag delta > 50k.
Kira Patel: I'll file PR for memory bump and HPA config. scheduling canary deploy later today.
incident-bot: RESOLUTION: PagerDuty INC12345 marked resolved by Kira Patel at 02:19 UTC. Root-cause suspected: exporter-side resets causing scrape-proxy retry storms and downstream consumer backlog. Follow-ups created: INFR-2174 (postmortem), PR#3456 (scrape-proxy memory/HPA).
Anna O'Neil: thanks all — nice fast recovery. Lia, please keep customers updated and close support tickets once metrics fully validate.
Lia Chen: will do. sending final update to customers and closing tickets when confirmed.
James L: adding a note to run a synthetic scrape test during low-traffic hours and tune exporter timeouts.
Kira Patel: closing thread here. tagging for follow-up meeting tomorrow for RCA. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty: Incident INC12345 transitioned to resolved.
